The '''Induparans''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] race that inhabited the [[Induparan Crown Worlds]]. Ruled by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Dahon Indupar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Induparans were also controlled by several [[Noble/Legends|noble]] political houses.<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
